summary: Verified Razorpay payments integration in DISABLED state (keys empty). Backend: 11/11 payment tests pass — /payments/config returns enabled=false, key_id=null, currency=INR, session_price=1000, and the 3 plans (monthly ₹10000 / quarterly ₹30000 / annual ₹50000); /payments/order returns 503 for both plan and session while disabled; /payments/verify returns 503; /payments/history returns [] initially; all 4 endpoints return 401 without auth. Booking create/list/cancel still works. Frontend: nav-membership visible for both strength (pwuser) and muscle_fat (Google) users; /membership renders payments-disabled banner, membership-status card ('No active membership'), 3 plan cards with correct ₹10,000/₹30,000/₹50,000 prices and DISABLED 'Coming soon' subscribe buttons, and payment history section with 'No payments yet'. Booking page shows Unpaid chip (no pay button) for unpaid bookings while disabled. Regression: /workouts, /progress, /bodyscan, /food, /booking all load without errors for authenticated users.
action_items: None for this iteration. Once Razorpay keys are added to backend/.env (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET), re-run this suite — the 503 assertions in test_payments.py will need to be inverted to expect 200 for /order and success flows for /verify.
Pre-existing (from iteration_2): brute-force lockout uses request.client.host which is fragmented behind the K8s ingress — should read X-Forwarded-For. Unrelated to payments but still open.
critical_code_review_comments: Payments disabled path is well-designed: /payments/config never exposes key_id when PAYMENTS_ENABLED is false, and both /order and /verify short-circuit to 503 before touching the razorpay client — no accidental import errors when keys are missing.

Frontend Membership.js correctly uses data-testid on all interactive/informational nodes (payments-disabled-banner, membership-status, plan-{id}, subscribe-{id}, payment-history) and disables subscribe buttons via config.enabled — matches spec exactly.

focus.js exposes membership via FEATURE_META and navForFocus always appends 'membership' regardless of focus programme, and focusAllowsPath returns true for /membership — so any authenticated user (any focus) sees and can access Membership. Verified for both strength and muscle_fat.

Booking.js reads /payments/config on mount and conditionally renders Pay button vs Unpaid chip — payment gate correct. paySession uses payWithRazorpay which lazy-loads checkout.js only on click, so no script fetch happens while disabled.
Backend /payments/order performs booking lookup with user_id scoping — good tenant isolation for the session flow.
server.py is now 762 lines — still under the 700-line soft cap by a small margin; if payments/webhook logic grows, consider splitting payments into /app/backend/routers/payments.py.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Membership UI, Booking Unpaid state, regression on Workouts/Progress/BodyScan/Food/Booking all pass)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test created and deleted a booking (2026-12-30) during the frontend regression run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET are populated in backend/.env and PAYMENTS_ENABLED becomes true, the 503 assertions in /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py need to be inverted: /order should return 200 with {order_id, amount, currency, key_id}, /verify should still 404/400 without a real razorpay order+signature. The frontend subscribe buttons should read 'Subscribe' and be enabled; Booking page should show a 'Pay ₹1000' button for unpaid bookings. Do NOT run any test that actually completes a Razorpay payment in test mode without user consent — signature verification will fail with fake payment_id/signature (that is the expected 400 path). The pre-existing brute-force IP fragmentation bug is still open (iteration_2).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Payments-disabled graceful degradation works as specified.
